description:
Cast Black Lotus by paying {0}.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Cast Black Lotus from your graveyard for its retrace cost by discarding a land card.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Cast Invasion of Shandalar from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {3}{G}{G} and discarding a land card.
